instructions: Read every complete case in the paired workbook. The default is only a draft. Put a full Decision object in Override for every contradiction, then sign reviewedAllCases. The compiler refuses unsigned or candidate-less rows.

rows.Kwic: 汝等諸人，各具金剛眼睛，到者裏作麼生會？

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Langya Huijue section. Langya Huijue is the exact hall speaker: addressing the assembly with his staff, he says that each person possesses diamond eyes and asks how they understand here.

rows.Kwic: 少室巖前，祖師斷臂。且道斷臂作箇什麼？卓拄杖一下，下座。

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Ciming Chuyuan section. Ciming Chuyuan is the exact hall speaker: he invokes the patriarch cutting off his arm before Shaoshi Cliff, asks what the cutting accomplished, strikes once with the staff, and steps down.

rows.Kwic: 此三轉語，一句壁立千仞，一句陸地行船，一句賓主交參。眾中莫有揀得出者麼？

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Cuiyan Kezhen section. Cuiyan Kezhen is the exact speaker: in his discourse he classifies three turning phrases as a thousand-fathom wall, sailing a boat on land, and guest and host intermingling, then asks the assembly to distinguish them.

rows.Kwic: 了無求，隨分討，糞掃堆頭拾得寶。

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Changling Shouzhuo section. Changling Shouzhuo is the exact verse author: he says that without seeking and according to one's share, one picks up treasure atop a rubbish heap.

rows.Kwic: 眨眼滲漏，開口蹉過，計較不成，依前懡㦬。拘那含牟尼佛

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Zhenxie Qingliao's verses praising the seven buddhas. Zhenxie Qingliao is the exact verse author: immediately before the heading for Kanakamuni Buddha, his preceding verse says that calculation fails and one remains embarrassed as before.

rows.Kwic: 德山棒、臨濟喝，是三世諸佛慈悲喜捨之樂。

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Yun'an Kewen section. Yun'an Kewen is the exact speaker: distinguishing three kinds of joy, he names Deshan's blows and Linji's shouts as the joy of the buddhas' kindness, compassion, sympathetic joy, and equanimity.

rows.Kwic: 動時常寂寂，靜處活鱍鱍。動靜兩俱忘，佛祖何處著。

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Jinsu Zhi section. Jinsu Zhi is the exact hall-verse speaker: he contrasts being constantly still while moving with being vividly alive in stillness, then says both movement and stillness are forgotten.

rows.Kwic: 一口吸盡西江水，萬古千古無一滴。要須黨理不黨親，馬師可惜口門窄。

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Baiyun Shouduan section. Baiyun Shouduan is the exact verse author: his verse takes up swallowing the West River in one mouthful, says not one drop remains through all ages, and appraises Mazu's mouth as regrettably narrow.

rows.Kwic: 忘却祖師禪，拾得箇骨董。

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Wuzu Fayan section. Wuzu Fayan is the exact hall speaker: after half a month away from the assembly, he says he forgot ancestral-teacher Chan and picked up an antique, then asks where to put it.

rows.Kwic: 雖不立窠臼露布，久之學徒妄認，亦成窠臼露布也。盖以無窠臼為窠臼

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Yuanwu Keqin's instruction to the scribe Yu. Yuanwu Keqin is the exact author: he warns that students turn even a great lineage teacher's refusal to establish a mold into another mold and make absence of a posted formula into a posted formula.

rows.Kwic: 謂之貼肉汗衫，謂之解脫深坑，又謂之死水，又謂之墨汁，又謂之明白。

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Ying'an Tanhua section. Ying'an Tanhua is the exact small-gathering speaker: contrasting his own appraisal with what other teachers protect, he calls the claimed condition a skin-tight shirt, a liberation pit, dead water, ink, and clarity.

rows.Kwic: 眾中莫有透出重關者麼？出來與華藏相見。良久，云：無人知此意，令我憶南泉。

Override.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Dun'an Zongyan section. Dun'an Zongyan is the exact Mid-Autumn hall speaker: after raising Hanshan's moon verse, he asks whether anyone can emerge through the heavy barrier and come meet Huazang, pauses, and remembers Nanquan.
